Name: Panda as Farm Animal
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[b]After you have earned 500,000G on your farm, Marnie will visit your farm. From that point on, pandas can be kept as new barn animals.
When pandas have low affection, they will give you honey or a treasure totem as gifts. Once their affection reaches medium or higher, the accompanying camera will take photos of the pandas.
They take six days to grow.
Three new items are added: a single photo of a panda (base price: 700G), a photo album of pandas (base price: 5,000G), and an observation report on pandas (base price: 1,000G).
The final daily profit is approximately 4,500G.
In addition, pandas have a chance to change fur color.
在你农场挣够500000G后，玛妮会拜访你的农场。自此以后，熊猫就可以作为新的畜棚动物了。熊猫们低好感时会送你蜂蜜或者宝藏图腾作为礼物，在好感达到中等以上之后，伴随的相机会拍下熊猫们的照片。需要六天成长。新增三个物品：熊猫的单张照片，基础售价700；熊猫的照片册，基础售价5000；熊猫的观察报告，基础售价1000.最终的收益约为4500G一日。此外，熊猫有概率出现毛色变化。[/b]
